_comment: Single source of truth for exercise definitions, loaded by BOTH runtimes:
Changing a threshold here changes it everywhere. Previously these numbers
were duplicated by hand in each runtime and had already drifted apart -
the web engine was measuring the shoulder joint while Python measured the
elbow, using identical thresholds for both.
Landmark indices are MediaPipe Pose indices.
_tolerancesComment: Set from measured distributions over the recorded training library
(62 curl reps, 66 press reps), not from ideal-form theory. Nobody hits
exact numbers, so each tolerance sits above normal human variation and
only clearly poor execution is flagged. Deductions ramp rather than
cliff - see graded_penalty() - so a near miss costs a little and a big
Before this tuning, 61% of real press reps and 46% of real curl reps
were flagged as faulty, which trains users to ignore the coach.

tolerances._driftNote: Torso-relative, in shoulder-widths (~40cm), so 0.50 is ~20cm of elbow travel - a visible swing, not a wobble. Measured curl drift: median 0.19, p75 0.39, p90 0.92. A tighter 0.30 flagged 35% of ordinary reps.
tolerances._symmetryNote: Measured press asymmetry: median 35.5deg. The old 20deg (35deg effective) flagged half of all normal reps.
tolerances._tempoNote: Full-rep duration, not eccentric-only. Measured medians: 1.24s curl, 1.10s press; p25 0.70/0.80. 0.5s flags only a genuine bounce.
tolerances._faultConfirmNote: Consecutive frames a fault must hold before counting. Per-rep max()/min() tracking latches onto the worst single frame, so debouncing is what removes noise-driven faults.

bicep._angleComment: Elbow flexion: shoulder -> elbow -> wrist. Low = contracted.
bicep._thresholdComment: Crossed with +/- tolerances.angleDeg applied at check time.
bicep._rampsComment: How far past tolerance counts as a full-weight miss. Measured curl ROM: peak median 6deg (p90 40), bottom median 172deg (p10 153).

_angleComment: Elbow extension: shoulder -> elbow -> wrist. High = locked out.
The web engine used to measure elbow -> shoulder -> hip here, a
different joint entirely, while applying these same thresholds.
shoulder._rampsComment: Measured press ROM: lockout median 170deg (p10 164), bottom median 28deg (p90 43). Both were already tolerant; the ramps stop a marginal miss costing full weight.
shoulder._faultsComment: symmetryMidRange fires while still pressing; symmetry fires at lockout, where an imbalance is more serious.
